r: Tender salmon fillets baked in the oven with lemon, dill and a drizzle of olive oil.
Place the fillets in a dish, skin-side down.
Drizzle with oil, add lemon slices, the dill, salt and pepper.
Bake for 15 min: the middle should still be slightly translucent.|Oven|15
A mustard and honey glaze caramelises on top.
A sweet and savoury mustard and honey glazed salmon.
Mix the mustard, honey and the juice of the lemon.
Brush over the fillets, then add salt and pepper.
The vegetables cook on the same tray as the salmon.
The full meal on one tray: salmon, broccoli and potatoes.
Put the halved potatoes on a tray with 2 tbsp of oil, salt and paprika. Bake for 20 min.|Oven|20
Add the broccoli florets and the salmon fillets, drizzled with oil and lemon.
Flaky cod baked in the oven with a lemon and parsley butter.
Place the cod in a dish and season with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter with the garlic, the lemon juice and the parsley, and pour over the fish.
The fish cooks on a tomato and olive sauce.
A sunny cod dish with tomato, olives and thyme.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the tomatoes, olives and thyme. Cook for 10 min.|Cooking|10
Pour into a dish, lay the cod on top, and season with salt and pepper.
A breadcrumb and parmesan crust makes the top crunchy.
Fish that is crunchy on top and tender inside, which kids like.
Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and melted butter.
Place the cod in a dish, season with salt and cover with the mixture.
Mussels steamed open in white wine, with shallots and parsley.
Scrub and rinse the mussels, and throw away any that are open.
Soften the sliced shallots in the butter in a large pot.
Add the wine and mussels, cover and cook for 6 min over a high heat, shaking the pot.|Cooking|6
Sprinkle with parsley and pepper. Serve with chips or bread.
Moules marinières with a creamy sauce.
Soften the shallots in the butter, add the wine and mussels, cover and cook for 6 min.|Cooking|6
Take out the mussels, add the cream to the juices and let it reduce for 3 min.|Cooking|3
Pour the sauce over the mussels and sprinkle with parsley.
A coconut curry sauce replaces the wine.
Mussels in a coconut curry sauce.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil with the curry powder for 2 min.
Add the coconut milk and mussels, cover and cook for 6 min.|Cooking|6
Prawns pan-fried with garlic and parsley, in 10 minutes.
Peel the prawns, keeping the tails on.
Heat the oil with the chopped garlic and the chilli for 1 min.
Add the prawns and sauté for 3 min, until pink.|Pan|3
Add the parsley, the lemon juice and the salt.
A creamy garlic sauce, to serve with pasta.
Prawns in a creamy garlic sauce, perfect over tagliatelle.
Sauté the prawns in the butter for 3 min. Set aside.|Pan|3
Fry the garlic for 1 min, add the cream and parmesan, and let it thicken for 3 min.|Cooking|3
Put the prawns back in and sprinkle with parsley.
A coconut curry sauce, to serve with rice.
Prawns in a mild coconut curry.
Fry the onion, ginger and curry powder in the oil for 3 min.|Cooking|3
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk, and cook for 10 min.|Cooking|10
Add the prawns and cook for 4 min.|Cooking|4
Salt cod mixed into a garlic and olive oil mash, then browned in the oven.
The day before, soak the cod in cold water, changing the water 3 times.
Poach the cod for 10 min in the milk, then flake it.|Cooking|10
Boil the potatoes for 20 min and mash them.|Cooking|20
Mix the mash, cod, chopped garlic, oil and a little of the cooking milk. Add pepper.
Pour into a dish, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake for 20 min at 200 °C.|Oven|20
Fresh cod replaces the salt cod: no soaking.
Brandade without waiting a day, made with fresh cod.
Poach the cod for 8 min in the milk, then crumble it.|Cooking|8
Mash the potatoes with the fish, garlic, oil and a little milk. Add salt and pepper.
Pour into a dish, sprinkle with emmental and bake for 15 min at 200 °C.|Oven|15
A mild salmon brandade that everyone likes.
Poach the salmon for 8 min in the milk and flake it.|Cooking|8
Mash the potatoes with the salmon, cream and dill, then add salt and pepper.
Pour into a dish, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake for 15 min at 200 °C.|Oven|15
Fish steamed in its parcel, with julienned vegetables and lemon.
Cut the vegetables into thin matchsticks and divide them between 4 sheets of baking paper.
Place the fish on top and add a slice of lemon, the thyme, the oil, salt and pepper.
Close up the parcels and bake for 18 min.|Oven|18
Salmon replaces the cod, with leeks.
Tender salmon in a parcel on a bed of leeks.
Soften the sliced leeks in a pan for 5 min.|Pan|5
Divide them between 4 parcels, add the salmon, a little cream, the dill, the lemon, salt and pepper.
Close up and bake for 15 min.|Oven|15
Soy sauce, ginger and lime flavour the fish.
A parcel flavoured with ginger and soy.
Put the sliced pak choi on 4 sheets of paper, then the fish.
Drizzle with soy sauce, and add the ginger, lime and spring onion.
Close up and bake for 15 min.|Oven|15
Raw salmon cut by hand, with lime, shallot and herbs.
Cut the salmon into small, even cubes.
Mix with the chopped shallot, chives, oil, the juice of the limes, salt and pepper.
A layer of avocado and mango under the salmon.
A fresh, colourful tartare of salmon, avocado and mango.
Cut the salmon, avocado and mango into small cubes.
Season the salmon with the oil, half the lime juice and the salt, and the avocado with the rest of the lime.
Build in a ring mould: avocado, mango, then salmon, and sprinkle with coriander.
Seasoned with soy sauce, sesame and ginger.
A Japanese-style tartare with soy and sesame.
Cut the salmon into small cubes.
Mix with the soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, the lime juice and the sliced spring onion.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve well chilled.
A whole sea bream roasted in the oven with lemon, fennel and herbs.
Put the sliced fennel in the bottom of a dish with 2 tbsp of oil.
Slip lemon slices, garlic and thyme inside the fish, and season with salt and pepper.
Lay them on the fennel, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake for 25 min.|Oven|25
A full meal: sea bream on a bed of potatoes.
Put the thinly sliced potatoes in a dish with the oil, salt and thyme. Bake for 20 min.|Oven|20
Add the sea bream stuffed with lemon, and the cherry tomatoes.
Sea bream fillets grilled skin-side down.
Fillets with crispy skin, in 10 minutes.
Lightly score the skin of the fillets.
Cook them skin-side down for 4 min in very hot oil.|Pan|4
Flip them for 1 min, then serve with the lemon and fleur de sel.|Pan|1
White fish in a crispy beer batter, with chips.
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry them for 6 min at 160 °C, then drain.|Frying|6
Mix the flour, baking powder, salt and cold lager.
Dip the fish in a little flour and then in the batter, and fry for 5 min at 180 °C.|Frying|5
Fry the chips again for 3 min at 180 °C until golden.|Frying|3
The fish is breaded and the chips are baked, with no deep-frying.
A lighter fish and chips, all in the oven.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into chips, toss with 3 tbsp of oil and some salt, and bake for 20 min.|Oven|20
Dip the fish in the flour, the beaten egg and then the breadcrumbs.
Put it on another tray, drizzle with oil and bake everything for 15 min.|Oven|15
Breaded pan-fried fish sticks, for kids.
Homemade fish fingers, crunchy and golden.
Cut the fish into sticks and add salt.
Dip them in the flour, the beaten egg and then the breadcrumbs.
Brown them in the oil for 3 min on each side.|Pan|6
